# redis

```go
import "github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/backend/redis"
```

Package redis is a gashe.Backend on top of a go\-redis client: a single node, a Sentinel failover client or a Cluster.

## type [Backend](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/backend/redis/redis.go#L41-L47>)

Backend is a gashe.Backend over a go\-redis client.

```go
type Backend struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/backend/redis/redis.go#L53>)

```go
func New(client goredis.UniversalClient) *Backend
```

New returns a Backend over client. The caller owns client and closes it; Backend.Close does nothing.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>

Without an Output line it compiles but does not run: it needs a Redis server.

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"

	"github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe"

	gasheredis "github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/backend/redis"
)

func main() { //nolint:testableexamples // needs a Redis server
	ctx := context.Background()
	client := goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{Addr: "localhost:6379"})
	defer func() { _ = client.Close() }()
	c := gashe.New(gasheredis.New(client), gashe.Options{Prefix: "orders:"})

	user, err := gashe.GetOrLoad(ctx, c, "user:42", gashe.Policy[string]{TTL: gashe.TTL{For: time.Hour}},
		func(context.Context) (string, error) { return "Ann", nil })
	fmt.Println(user, err)
}
```

</p>
</details>

<a name="Bus"></a>
## type [Bus](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/backend/redis/bus.go#L17-L20>)

Bus carries near cache invalidations over Redis pub/sub; it implements nearcache.Bus. Only key names are sent. Pub/sub messages are broadcast to every node, so it works on a Cluster too.

```go
type Bus struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewBus"></a>
### func [NewBus](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/backend/redis/bus.go#L24>)

```go
func NewBus(client goredis.UniversalClient, channel string) *Bus
```

NewBus returns a Bus on channel. Use one channel per set of processes that share the same keys. The caller owns client. It panics on an empty channel.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>

A near cache over Redis whose Bus tells the other processes which keys changed. Without an Output line it compiles but does not run: it needs a Redis server.

```go
package main

import (
	"time"

	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"

	"github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe"
	"github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/backend/memory"
	"github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/backend/nearcache"

	gasheredis "github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/backend/redis"
)

func main() { //nolint:testableexamples // needs a Redis server
	client := goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{Addr: "localhost:6379"})
	defer func() { _ = client.Close() }()
	local := memory.New(memory.Options{MaxEntries: 10_000})
	defer local.Close()

	near := nearcache.New(local, gasheredis.New(client), nearcache.Options{
		LocalTTL: time.Minute,
		Bus:      gasheredis.NewBus(client, "orders:changed"),
	})
	defer func() { _ = near.Close() }()
	c := gashe.New(near, gashe.Options{})
	_ = c
}
```

</p>
</details>

<a name="Bus.Subscribe"></a>
### func \(\*Bus\) [Subscribe](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/backend/redis/bus.go#L42>)

```go
func (b *Bus) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, changed func(keys []string)) error
```

Subscribe calls changed with every published list of keys until ctx is done. After every \(re\)subscription it calls changed\(nil\), since messages may have been lost.

<a name="TrackingBus"></a>
## type [TrackingBus](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/backend/redis/tracking.go#L16-L19>)

TrackingBus carries near cache invalidations from Redis itself, with client side caching \(CLIENT TRACKING in broadcast mode\); it implements nearcache.Bus. Redis reports every change of a key under the prefix, whoever makes it: gashe, redis\-cli or another service. Needs Redis 6 or Valkey; a Cluster is not supported, use Bus there.

```go
type TrackingBus struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewTrackingBus"></a>
### func [NewTrackingBus](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/backend/redis/tracking.go#L24>)

```go
func NewTrackingBus(client *goredis.Client, prefix string) *TrackingBus
```

NewTrackingBus returns a TrackingBus for the keys starting with prefix; "" means every key. It opens a connection of its own with the options of client while Subscribe runs; the caller owns client.

<a name="TrackingBus.Publish"></a>
### func \(\*TrackingBus\) [Publish](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/backend/redis/tracking.go#L29>)

```go
func (*TrackingBus) Publish(context.Context, []string) error
```

Publish does nothing: Redis reports changes by itself.

<a name="TrackingBus.Subscribe"></a>
### func \(\*TrackingBus\) [Subscribe](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/backend/redis/tracking.go#L34>)

```go
func (b *TrackingBus) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, changed func(keys []string)) error
```

Subscribe calls changed with the keys Redis reports until ctx is done, and changed\(nil\) after every \(re\)connection and FLUSHDB. If Redis refuses tracking, it keeps trying every second, and local copies live up to LocalTTL.
